title: On-Time Arrival Credit: Amount and Earning Terms, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
**Guarantee.** In call classes of Repair and Emergency Service Calls whose on-time credit is above zero, Harbison guarantees arrival within the booked window. A call class whose on-time credit is zero earns no credit.

**When it is earned.** The on-time credit is earned when the technician arrived after the end of the booked arrival window plus the call class's late-arrival grace of 15 minutes. It is also earned when the technician arrived on a later calendar day than the scheduled date. The arrival moment, the booked window and the scheduled date are read from the call record.

**Amount.** The on-time credit is the class's on-time credit as listed on the class schedule. It is figured to the cent half up. Amounts are carried at full precision until the single rounding. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded up to the higher cent; for this purpose an amount within 1e-09 of a dollar below the half cent counts as exactly halfway.

**Posting.** It is posted as one late-arrival credit line naming the visit's diagnostic fee line and the customer's agreement.

**Ceiling.** The on-time credit is measured against the balance owing on the whole invoice, not against the amount left on the diagnostic fee line it names. It never exceeds the balance owing on the invoice when it posts, and it is never less than zero.

**One per call.** Only one on-time credit is posted per call.

## When the technician counts as late (15-minute grace)

| Booked window | Arrival at or before this moment is on time | Arrival after it earns the credit |
|---|---|---|
| 08:00-12:00 | 12:15 | Yes |
| 12:00-17:00 | 17:15 | Yes |
| 17:00-22:00 | 22:15 | Yes |

An arrival at 12:15 exactly on an 08:00-12:00 window is not after the end of the window plus the grace. An arrival at 12:16 is. An arrival at 09:00 on the day after the scheduled date earns the credit, whatever the window.

## Worked examples (hypothetical calls, $25.00 class credit)

| Arrival | Balance owing on the invoice when the credit posts | Credit posted |
|---|---|---|
| 12:40 on a 08:00-12:00 window | $214.00 | $25.00 |
| 12:10 on a 08:00-12:00 window | — | None (on time) |
| 17:30 on a 12:00-17:00 window | $18.00 | $18.00 (the balance owing on the whole invoice) |
| Any late arrival, Overnight Emergency Service Call (class credit $0.00) | — | None |
